Pitt's first paid Hollywood job, shot in November 1987, three days after arriving from Missouri. He plays a hotel bellboy in the second episode of this short-lived CBS sitcom. Zero jeopardy.

Aired March 22, 1988; the series was cancelled after three episodes.
